meta.title: Done-with-you
meta.description: Get Udaan ki team ke saath apna AI reel page banao — character, pehli videos, page setup aur growth plan.

hero.title: APNA PAGE, *HAMARI TEAM* KE SAATH
hero.sub: Akele shuru karna mushkil lagta hai? Hamari team aapke saath baith kar aapka character, pehli videos aur page setup karti hai.

steps.title: Onboarding
steps.desc: Hum aapka goal, niche aur audience samajhte hain.

steps.title: Character
steps.desc: Hamari team aapke page ka character design karti hai.

steps.title: Pehli videos
steps.desc: Pehli videos hum aapke saath milkar banate hain, taaki aap poora tareeka seekh jao.

steps.title: Page setup
steps.desc: Bio, highlights aur posting ka setup — page launch ke liye taiyaar.

steps.title: Growth plan
steps.desc: Aage ke dino ke liye ek saaf plan: kya post karna hai aur kab.

included.title: ISME *KYA* MILEGA
included.sub: Jo likha hai wahi milega — na kam, na chhupa hua kuch.
included.noGuarantee: Views, followers ya income ki koi guarantee nahi. Hum setup aur tareeka dete hain; page chalana aur regular post karna aapka kaam hai.

items.q: Ye course se kaise alag hai?
items.a: Isme Pro course ka sab kuch milta hai, aur saath mein hamari team aapke page par aapke saath kaam karti hai.

items.q: Slot book karne ke baad kya hoga?
items.a: Payment ke baad hamari team aapse WhatsApp ya email par contact karke onboarding shuru karegi.

items.q: Kya views ya kamaai ki guarantee hai?
items.a: Nahi. Koi bhi honest team ye guarantee nahi de sakti. Results aapki mehnat, consistency aur content par depend karte hain.
Razorpay ke through — UPI, card ya netbanking. Hum aapke card ya UPI ki details store nahi karte.
Refund ke saare rules hamari Refund policy mein likhe hain. Slot book karne se pehle use ek baar padh lijiye.

final.title: TAIYAAR *HO?*
final.sub: Slot book kijiye. Aage ka kaam hum saath mein karenge.
